items.question: Do you list every city you can serve?
items.answer: No. Local proof content uses a request-review model. Share your city, venue, event date, and setup details so availability can be reviewed.

items.question: What details make service-area review faster?
items.answer: Helpful details include venue address, indoor or outdoor placement, available footprint, surface type, access path, rental dates, and expected attendance.

items.question: Can new city pages be created from this route?
items.answer: Future city or state pages require separate content, approval, and publish gates. This local source only repairs the canonical service-areas route.

items.question: Does this page confirm service everywhere?
items.answer: No. It explains the review process and avoids unsupported geographic claims until a request is reviewed.
